name: Cradle Fetch
text: Start of Combat: become a copy of the Fairy behind, Ring and all, with full stats.
golden_text: Start of Combat: become a golden copy of the Fairy behind, Ring and all, with full stats.
details: Rounds copied stats up and adds this slot's Ring. Copies the biggest Fairy behind; two Fetches never share a target.
golden_details: Becomes golden, including its text. Copies all the current stats, then adds this slot's Ring.
